title: 第9章 镇魂碑碎第10章 青衫镇乱
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
云擎望着场中负手而立的身影，心下顿时生出几分不妙。他今日这身打扮可不是为了武斗的，更何况与这位仙帝转世交手，哪里是“练练”，分明是“挨揍”。
云煌转过身，淡金眼瞳在曦光下流转着莫测的光芒，他在云擎那身和演武场格格不入的青衫上停顿了一瞬，唇角勾起难以捉摸的弧度，像是看穿了他那点小心思。
云擎回神，干脆先发制人，他快步踏入场中，趋至云煌身侧躬身行礼，声音温和恭谨：“少君晨安。”
云煌微微颔首。许是早早来此练功，他鎏金锦袍的领口处有一处不甚明显的折痕，与平日一丝不苟的仪态略有出入。
云擎上前半步，身姿从容，指尖蕴着一缕温和灵力，极轻极快地拂过那道折痕，将云煌衣襟妥帖抚平。收手时不经意擦过对方肩头，动作自然。
“少君仪容，当如日月经天，不容微瑕。”他垂眸，借着整理衣摆的动作，不着痕迹地拉近一丝距离，又迅速退回安全界限内。
云煌身体有瞬间的僵硬，金瞳落在他打理衣摆的手上。
他指尖无意识蜷缩了一下，到底没有避开。
“倒是…细心”
云擎直起身，衣摆云纹玉佩相撞，发出清脆的声响。他指着自己今日装束，语气带着几分恰到好处的无奈道：
“少君容禀。您看这青衫，束袖收腰，只为贴合随侍本分，连灵力流转都要收三分，若真动起手，怕是架势未开，衣衫先裂，既失仪君前，也怠慢了少君的切磋雅意。”他这话，既以衣饰不便婉拒，又暗赞与云煌切磋是体面之事，给足了台阶。
云煌扫过他那身清雅的衣衫，目光微顿，倒也不全是托词…
云擎今日的青衫衬得他身姿挺拔修长，但束腰收紧了灵力流转的关键穴位，衣摆坠的云纹玉佩更是侧重安神而非护具，确实不算动武的合适装束。
云煌最终只淡淡“嗯”了一声，并未动怒。
安抚奏效。
云擎舒朗一笑，说不出的温柔潇洒，“那擎就，多谢少君体谅。”
那笑容晃得云煌微怔。他昨日在阵图上被云擎一言点破，虽受益良多，但内心深处属于绝世天骄的好胜心也被隐隐挑起，今日确有借切磋“找回场面”的念头。
不过……罢了，也不是非要此刻切磋，云擎做甚么这般姿态。
就在云煌准备暂且放过他，拂袖转身之际——
“唰！”

一道黑影如同鬼魅般现身，单膝跪地，声音急促却恭敬：“禀少君，执律司贾执事有紧急事务求见！”
得到许可，贾执事匆匆冲上演武场，“扑通”一声跪倒在地，声音带着无法抑制的颤抖：
“禀…禀少君，宗祠外发生变故，家主一脉庶七子云烁与五长老一脉的嫡四子云浩起了冲突，混乱中竟震裂了宗祠门口的‘镇魂碑’！”
“镇魂碑”三字一出，如同惊雷炸响。
云煌眉头微蹙，那点刚升起的，对兄长的微妙心绪瞬间被冷厉取代。他周身气息骤然下沉，鎏金锦袍无风自动，如煌阳炸裂前的死寂威压，铺天盖地般笼罩下来。
content_en:
Yun Qing looked at the figure standing in the field with his hands behind his back, and suddenly felt something bad in his heart. The way he was dressed today was not for fighting, let alone fighting against the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor. Instead of "training", it was clearly "taking a beating".
Yunhuang turned around, his pale gold eyes shining unpredictably in the sunlight. He paused for a moment on Yun Qing's green shirt that was incompatible with the martial arts field, and the corners of his lips curved in an unpredictable way, as if he had seen through his little thoughts.
Yun Qing came back to his senses and decided to strike first. He quickly stepped into the field, walked to Yun Huang's side and bowed, his voice gentle and respectful: "Good morning, young gentleman."
Yunhuang nodded slightly. Xu Shi came here early to practice, and there was an inconspicuous crease at the collar of his gilded brocade robe, which was slightly different from his usual meticulous demeanor.
Yun Qing took half a step forward, his posture was calm, and his fingertips contained a wisp of gentle spiritual power. He brushed the crease very lightly and quickly, smoothing the hem of Yunhuang's clothes smoothly. When closing the hand, he inadvertently brushed the opponent's shoulder, his movements were natural.
"Young Master's appearance should be like that of the sun and the moon, with no room for flaws." He lowered his eyes, and by adjusting the hem of his clothes, he closed the distance without leaving a trace, and then quickly retreated to a safe limit.
Yunhuang's body stiffened for a moment, and his golden eyes fell on his hand that was arranging the hem of his clothes.
His fingertips curled up unconsciously, but he didn't avoid it.
"Quite... careful"
Yun Qing straightened up, and the cloud-patterned jade pendants on his clothes collided with each other, making a crisp sound. He pointed at his outfit today and said with a hint of helplessness in his tone:
"Young Master, you are so kind. Look at this green shirt. The sleeves are tied up and the waist is tightened just to suit the duty of serving as a servant. Even the flow of spiritual power has to be tightened by three points. If you really make a move, I am afraid that the clothes will tear before the posture is opened. It will not only be disrespectful to the Lord, but also neglect the elegance of Young Lord's sparring." His words not only declined due to the inconvenience of clothes, but also secretly praised that sparring with Yunhuang is a decent thing, which is a good step.
Yunhuang glanced at his elegant clothes and paused slightly, but it wasn't all an excuse...
Yun Qing's green shirt today made him tall and slender, but the waistband tightened the key acupuncture points for the circulation of spiritual power. The cloud-patterned jade pendant hanging from the hem of his clothes was more focused on calming the mind rather than protective gear. It was indeed not a suitable attire for using force.
In the end, Yunhuang just said a faint "hmm" and did not get angry.
The reassurance works.
Yun Qing smiled comfortably, with an indescribable gentleness and ease, "That's it, Qing. Thank you for your understanding, young gentleman."
That smile made Yunhuang slightly startled. Yesterday, he was criticized by Yun Qing on the formation map. Although he benefited a lot, the competitive spirit of a peerless genius deep down in his heart was also faintly aroused. Today, he did have the idea of ​​​​recovering the scene through the competition.
But... that's all, it's not necessary to discuss what Yun Qing should do at this moment.
Just when Yunhuang was about to let him go for the time being and turn around——
"Uh-huh!"
A black shadow appeared like a ghost, kneeling on one knee, and said in a quick but respectful voice: "Young Master, Deacon Jia of the Law Enforcement Department has urgent matters to see you!"
After receiving permission, Deacon Jia hurriedly rushed to the martial arts arena and fell to his knees with a plop, his voice trembling uncontrollably:
"Report... Young Master, something happened outside the ancestral hall. Yun Shuo, the seventh son of the family head, and Yun Hao, the fourth son of the fifth elder, had a conflict. In the chaos, the 'soul-calming monument' at the entrance of the ancestral hall was actually shattered!"
As soon as the words "soul-suppressing monument" came out, it was like a thunderous explosion.
Yunhuang frowned slightly, and the subtle feelings towards his brother that had just risen were instantly replaced by coldness. The aura around him suddenly sank, and the gilded brocade robe moved automatically without wind, like the deathly pressure before the brilliant sun exploded, overwhelmingly covering the sky and the earth.
